metadata.title: सोडा बनाने की प्राचीन विधि| Taste of the Tribe:  A Probiotic Delight from Tripura
metadata.description:
Khar Pani is a traditional alkaline solution crafted by the tribes of Tripura, celebrated for its unique role in their culinary traditions. Made by filtering water through the ash of burnt banana peels or other organic materials, Khar Pani serves as a natural soda with a mild, earthy flavor and significant health benefits. This versatile ingredient is integral to the preparation of Chakwhi, a probiotic-rich dish beloved by the Tripuri community.

Chakwhi, typically a hearty stew, combines locally sourced vegetables, fermented bamboo shoots, and sometimes dried fish or meat. The addition of Khar Pani enhances the dish’s flavor profile while promoting fermentation, aiding digestion, and boosting gut health. This age-old cooking technique exemplifies the tribes’ deep understanding of natural food processing and their sustainable approach to living. Khar Pani is not just an ingredient but a testament to the Tripuri people's resourcefulness and their connection to nature.
